lines.text: I am going to try my best to intimidate and bully you.

Lord Jesus, I thank You for Your mercy (Psalm 103:2).
And Lord Jesus, I thank You for Your grace (Ephesians 4:7).
But today, Lord Jesus, I choose to thank You and Your Son for the glory of His name (1 Peter 3:2).
Please help me to honor You and rely on Your love, for I have no need of anything but Christ (Colossians 3:4).
